mutations:** none
**Requirement ids:** `DF-S2.3-1` · `BL-12` · `R-2.2.2` · `R-2.2.3` · `R-2.6.1`

## Summary

Discharges the R2.3-assigned residual of DF-S2.3-1 — the S2.3 machinery
landed `wakeup_subscribe`/`occurred`/`fire`/`drain`/`cancel`,
`Store::suspend`/`compensate_run`, `EnvDriver::heal_with_policy`, but the
*producing* call sites and the protocol entry points stayed deferred to
their owning tickets. This run lands:

1. **The producer pass** (`Store::deliver_wakeup` → `wakeup_producers`) —
   the durable producing rows mint the subscriptions occurrence synthesis
   then reads, under the caller's writer lease, before any `wakeup_due`
   work: `control.retry.scheduled{scope_id}` produces one `retry_due`
   subscription per scope (`created_by` = the scheduled row); a `fired`
   occurrence still withheld by `deliver_after` (W-3) produces the
   `effect_terminal` subscription for the blocking committed effect, so
   the run re-cues when it folds terminal. Live-cover dedup replaces a
   cancelled/expired sub and reuses a live one — one sub per
   scope/effect, never per row. The pass reads durable state only, so a
   same-call withheld fire lands its leg on the *next* pass —
   durable-before-visible by construction (KP-11 restart discipline
   unchanged). The non-fleet `timer` leg lands at the pending-permission
   seam: a deadline-bearing `pending` mints `Trigger::Timer` durable
   before any occurrence it synthesizes.
2. **`suspend{session_id, reasons, subscription_ids?, resume_policy?,
   release_lease?}`** — writer-session + writer-lease only. Waiting
   reasons mint (or reuse live cover for) their producing subscriptions
   — `awaiting_approval → PermissionDecided`, `awaiting_timer → Timer`,
   `awaiting_child → ChildTerminal`, `awaiting_effect → EffectTerminal`
   (validated against the effect fold), `awaiting_event` naming an
   existing subscription — **before** `lifecycle.run.suspended` lands.
   S-1 is pre-checked (`prepared`/`deferred`/`committed` ⇒
   `OpenCommittedEffects`) so a refused suspend mints no orphaned
   producers. `release_lease` defaults `true`; a released lease detaches
   the session (`detached:"suspended"`).
3. **`compensate{session_id, after_seq?, outcomes?}`** — the compensation
   saga over applied, compensable effects in reverse commit order under
   the writer lease. `outcomes{effect_id: payload | {"error": reason}}`
   is the host's declared dispatch; a missing entry is the honest
   `CompensatorMissing` leg — `abandoned` +
   `lifecycle.escalation.raised`, never a fabricated `observed`. The
   response reports the saga's own sums
   (`compensated`/`abandoned`/`in_flight`/`escalations`).
4. **`heal{session_id, policy_ref?, policy?}`** — the live verdict is
   *measured* (`verify_environment_verdict`, never the stale handle);
   `attached` ⇒ `Refused{environment_attached}`; a non-attached `ready`
   handle is marked `unreachable` durable before `heal_with_policy` runs
   the ladder — `healed{restored, lost_items_ref, heal_no}` |
   `ask{permission_id}` | `refused{reason}` verbatim (R-NOSIDE: the env
   handle never leaves the kernel). A healed successor rebinds the
   session's `env_handle_id`.
5. **`healing_policy_ref` end to end** — `connection_info{
   healing_policy_ref}` stamps `manifest.healing_policy_ref` at open;
   `heal` resolves inline `policy` > `policy_ref` > manifest ref > the
   attendance default (`interactive → ask`, else `reprovision`) through
   the one `RegistryStore` (`HealingPolicy` JSON is the one codec —
   `to_json`/`from_json`, CC1). Unresolvable, policy-free, or malformed
   declared refs are typed `Refused` — a default is never substituted
   over a bad declaration.
6. **`connection_info{on_loss}`** — the declared loss posture
   (`fail_run` default preserved verbatim; `replace_from_image`/
   `replace_from_snapshot` open the ladder's replace rung; an unknown
   spelling is a typed `EnvironmentUnavailable` at open).
7. **Schema + dispatch** — the three ops registered in `hh-embed-schema`
   (typed `SuspendParams`/`CompensateParams`/`HealParams`,
   `Tier::Experimental`, writer group) and routed through
   `EmbedService::handle`; `hh-embed-1.schema.json`,
   `compat-1.matrix.json`, and the generated client regenerated via
   `scripts/check-drift.sh` (CC7 — additive; old clients get
   `ExperimentalRequired`, never `unknown`).

## Size note

The ticket budgets 1200 changed lines excl. generated/fixtures. The
implementation surface is ~854 lines; the mandated acceptance battery
is ~1,560 (11 R2.3 tests, each failing if its behaviour is removed) —
total ~2,414 excl. records. The overrun vs the strictest reading is
battery weight the ticket itself requires (same accounting as R2.2); a
decompose split was weighed and rejected since the contract is atomic
(producer pass → entry points → policy resolution → posture decode).
